parts:
The ctmm winter webinar will take place at the end of February. You can vote on the schedule here:

https://doodle.com/poll/sn6pd3h9ur3u5c79

You can also vote on the content here:

https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/PCYYHF3

As with previous ctmm webinars, you will need to message/email me your Skype username so that I can add you to the webinar group. If you've done this before, then you should still be a group member. "Skype for business" and "Microsoft Teams" are not compatible with Skype's group call feature. There is a 50 participant limit during the webinar.

Best,
Chris

messages.author: c75afcf4ba885f1f
messages.subject: Re: ctmm winter webinar
parts:
Hi Chris, 

Sorry to be a pain, I already filled in the poll (so can't add in there again), but just thought of something I wish I'd put into the other things we'd like to learn about bit, so hope it's ok to add here!

It would be great to learn a bit more about what's stored in all the slots of e.g. the ctmm model fit objects, and when we might want to access those above and beyond summary outputs; or also how to apply the various functions in ctmm (mostly the ones that build off simulate/predict) on behaviorally segmented datasets, where there are usually (purposeful) gaps in the data. I have some ad hoc approaches I've used there but would be great to know what most appropriate ways of handling these are -- and how it might change the interpretation of outputs.

Thanks!

Gen
